15-Second Cinematic Prompt (Hollywood Trailer Style)

Scene 1 (0–3 sec) – The Hunt Begins
A violent blizzard sweeps across the Swiss Alps beneath a glowing full moon. The camera starts with an epic aerial shot of endless snow-covered peaks before descending into a frozen pine forest. A lone hunter in a weathered leather coat and fur-lined hood kneels beside enormous wolf footprints—far larger than any ordinary wolf. He brushes snow away from the tracks, realizing they are fresh. He loads a single silver bullet into his antique rifle, lifts an oil lantern, and steps into the darkness. The icy wind whistles through the trees, and a distant wolf howl echoes across the mountains.

Scene 2 (3–7 sec) – The White Guardian
The hunter reaches a frozen cliff overlooking the valley. Standing silently on the edge is a majestic white wolf, illuminated by cold moonlight. Its thick fur moves naturally in the wind, and its glowing blue eyes lock onto the hunter. Instead of attacking, the wolf slowly turns and walks toward a hidden mountain pass, pausing several times to look back as if guiding him. The hunter lowers his rifle and follows through a narrow canyon where ancient stone carvings, half-buried in snow, hint at a forgotten civilization.

Scene 3 (7–11 sec) – The Awakening
The wolf stops before a colossal glacier. Silence fills the valley. Suddenly the ground begins to shake violently. Massive cracks race across the frozen mountain, glowing with blue energy beneath the ice. Entire sections of the glacier collapse with thunderous force. From deep beneath the ice, an enormous stone hand slowly pushes through the glacier. Snow avalanches down the cliffs as the hunter stumbles backward in disbelief. The wolf stands perfectly still, staring at the awakening giant without fear.

Scene 4 (11–15 sec) – The Guardian's Truth
The hunter instinctively raises his rifle toward the emerging giant. Before he can pull the trigger, the white wolf steps directly in front of him, shielding the mountain. Time seems to slow. The hunter looks into the wolf's calm blue eyes and realizes the truth—it was never leading him to prey, but protecting an ancient guardian imprisoned beneath the Alps. Suddenly, two gigantic glowing blue eyes open inside the mountain. A deep roar echoes through the valley as snow erupts into the air. The wolf howls toward the sky while the camera rapidly pulls back, revealing the immense frozen landscape beneath the moon. Cut to black.

Create a self-contained interactive WebGPU page "Plush Crab" in the existing Material Studies plush series
(No. 020, fig. 20), matching the series' editorial layout: serif masthead, specimen control panel, live
readouts, collapsible "Inside the experiment" notes, English UI, works on mobile, graceful no-WebGPU fallback.

THE TOY: a cute plush crab sitting on a studio table. A wide, puffy domed shell with a flat seat and a soft
brow; two eyes on short stalks, each a fuzzy eyeball with a round white felt patch and a glossy safety eye;
an embroidered smile and soft blush cheeks; pale spots scattered over the top of the shell; a paler
underside; stitched seams where legs are sewn on. Real-time shell-texture fur (many shells, alpha-to-coverage,
MSAA) that lags behind jiggles and can be combed. Palettes: Coral (default), Sand, Blue (with red claw tips).

BODY: one SDF meshed with surface nets, simulated as an XPBD soft body (hex lattice, shape matching +
tetrahedral volume) under gravity and friction; it breathes, rights itself, can be grabbed, squashed,
lifted and thrown, and lands softly.

LEGS AND CLAWS: eight walking legs and two arms are rods with a plastic "wire" inside — posed toward
blended targets (sit, stand, hide, wave, hang), and bent legs keep the new shape until "Straighten".
Each arm ends in a chunky claw with two fat fingers that hang from the arm tip in the claw's own frame;
opening and closing is a single angle. Legs get pale joint bands and toes; claw fingers get dark tips.

BEHAVIOUR: "Scuttle" walks sideways (keeps its side to the goal) with an alternating gait and footholds;
"Snip snip" raises both claws and snaps them a beat apart (count snips in a readout); "Hide" pulls the legs in
and covers its eyes with the claws, then peeks out; "Wave claws" raises them high. With the Finger tool it
scuttles toward a held-out finger, turns to face it, reaches with its claws and gives a gentle pinch (toast);
poking the shell makes it hide. Held up in the air, legs dangle and paddle. Idle: small scuttles, snips, waves.

CONTROLS: tools Hand / Finger / Comb; sliders Stuffing, Pile, Wire; buttons Scuttle, Snip snip, Hide,
Wave claws, Straighten, Smooth fur, Reset; ¼ speed, Mesh, Pause. Readouts: Mass, Volume (% of rest),
Steps, Snips. Single HTML file, no external models or textures.

Podívej se na https://t.co/i8Q59bnXq1. Je to živá tapeta pro macOS: Swift agent položí na každý monitor okno s WKWebView pod ikony plochy a posílá do stránky polohu kurzoru. Naklonuj si ho do dočasné složky a prostuduj, hlavně `wallpaper/Wallpaper.swift` a instalační skripty.

Pak mi v aktuální prázdné složce postav vlastní tapetu „Moje tapeta“ se scénou „Vesmír“: noční obloha s Mléčnou dráhou, mlhovinou, hvězdami, kometami a padajícími hvězdami. Hvězdy i mlhovina před kurzorem uhýbají jako před antigravitačním polem a po jeho odjezdu se pružně vrátí na svá místa. Komety naopak kurzor přitahuje. Nativní část, `serve.mjs` a `scenes/shared/frame-loop.js` převezmi z repozitáře. Je pod licencí MIT, takže zachovej copyright a v LICENSE uveď, odkud kód je. Akvária ani Three.js nepotřebuju. Texty v aplikaci, komentáře v nastavení a README piš česky.

## Úpravy nativní části
- Scény hledej automaticky: každá podsložka `scenes/` s `index.html` a volitelným `scene.json` (`title`, `background`, `actions: [{id, title}]`). Akce se objeví v menu baru. Každý monitor dostane v adrese `?screen=N`, ať má jinou oblohu.
- Rozhraní pro stránku zobecni na `window.wallpaperHost.on('rate' | 'power' | 'action', handler)`. Hodnoty rate a power poslané dřív, než se scéna přihlásí, podrž a doruč. Kurzor dál chodí jako `pointermove` a `pointerleave`.
- Menu bar česky, s ikonou SF Symbol „sparkles“: stav, výběr scény, akce scény, Pozastavit/Pokračovat, Znovu načíst scénu, Ukončit.
- `kill -USR1` uloží snímek první obrazovky do /tmp/moje-tapeta.png, `kill -USR2` znovu načte scénu.
- Skripty v `host/`:
  - `https://t.co/gHG6shDVdx`: sestaví bundle.
  - `https://t.co/ty5WmX34LD`: dočasné spuštění přímo ze složky projektu, úpravy se projeví po „Znovu načíst“.
  - `https://t.co/lli0s4C224`: instalace do ~/Applications se spouštěním po přihlášení.
  - `https://t.co/SpaqH8sm6u`.
- Obrázek plochy neměň.
- Šetření energií (zakrytí okny, baterka, spánek obrazovky, úsporný režim, Omezení pohybu) nech, jak ho má originál.
